_README.description: Task definitions for evaluate_openvla_oft_baiqi.py. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
notes: Every string in a 'steps' list is sent to the policy verbatim as its instruction.
It MUST be one of the 24 instructions the policy was trained on, word for word.
Anything else is out of distribution for both the prompt and the FiLM conditioning.
Source of truth: training/2026-02-09-all/meta/tasks.jsonl (228 demos, 24 tasks).
The server lowercases the instruction, so case does not matter, but wording does.
Multi-stage sentences like 'move the cup to the right and pour the coke into the cup'
are single trained instructions -- do NOT split them into separate steps.
Multi-step tasks are for CHAINING several trained instructions; see the 'chain_*' entries.

steps: grasp the coke
grasp the fanta
grasp the sprite
pick up the cup on the left
pick up the cup in the middle
pick up the cup on the right
